title: Silverpine Forest
body: Silverpine Forest runs along the rugged western coast of Lordaeron, a country of tall silver-barked pines between Tirisfal and the Greymane Wall, behind which Gilneas has shut itself away. When the Scourge came, the archmage Arugal summoned worgen to fight them, and the beasts turned on the living as well. Now the Forsaken struggle to hold the forest against worgen, the Scourge and the wizards of Dalaran alike.

title: Valgan's Field
body: Valgan's Field is a small wheat farm on the shore of Lordamere Lake. When the archmage Arugal first came to Silverpine he stayed here, and he left behind a stack of dusty spellbooks, among them the spell he named his Remedy. Moonrage worgen, the cursed fruit of his magic, now prowl the farm.

parts.body: At the Argent Tournament in Icecrown a champion called the Black Knight claims to hail from Valgan's Field, and every rider set to face him has met an untimely end.
sources: quest 422 description (Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge, spellbooks, Remedy of Arugal)

parts.body: Nothing at the farm bears out his tale, and the tournament's crusaders now believe his story a sham, murderous at worst.

title: The Sepulcher
body: Built into an old crypt beside the road that crosses the forest, the Sepulcher is the Forsaken's base in Silverpine. In its graveyard lies the tomb of a paladin named Yuriv, its fine epitaph praising him as father, husband and servant of the Light, crudely scratched over with the word BETRAYER.

parts.body: Since the blood elves joined the Horde, Silvermoon keeps an envoy here too, counseling the High Executor that together they can make the Horde stronger than before.

Yuriv's widow has not forgiven him. Left waiting night after night while he put his crusade before her and their children, she sent a pendant back to lie upon his tomb, wanting nothing more to do with him.

title: Fenris Isle
body: Fenris Isle rises from Lordamere Lake, crowned by Fenris Keep, once a thriving military outpost of Lordaeron. Its people fled or died when the Scourge came, and now the Rot Hide gnolls swarm its shores and halls, holding the island as the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine.

title: Pyrewood Village
body: Pyrewood Village lies in southern Silverpine beneath Shadowfang Keep. Arugal's curse has given it two faces: by day its folk seem ordinary, keeping shop and standing watch, and when the sun goes down they become Moonrage worgen, bound by enchanted shackles and ruled through a council of his puppets.

parts.body: A vision of the past shows what became of Arugal after his death: princes of the San'layn came to Pyrewood and raised his shade for the Lich King, to be sent north to Solstice Village in the Grizzly Hills.

title: Ambermill
body: Ambermill was a minor lumber town in southeastern Silverpine until wizards of the Kirin Tor occupied it after the Third War. What draws Dalaran to so small a place is not plain to see, and to the Forsaken it is a stubborn knot of human opposition and a vault of Dalaran's secrets.

parts.body: The reason lies beneath the town. Ambermill sits on a dormant ley energy node that the Kirin Tor earmarked long ago, and the wizards are weaving their magic to wake it.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ambermill (town hall, stables, mills, lumber; Kirin Tor occupied after the Third War; dormant ley node)

parts.body: The archmage guiding the weaving falls, and the ley energies beneath Ambermill sink back into dormancy, though so great a source of power will not be forgotten.

title: The Greymane Wall
body: The Greymane Wall closes off the south of Silverpine, the great barrier King Genn Greymane raised to shut Gilneas away from the troubles of Lordaeron. Its gates stay shut against all who come to them. Refugees from fallen Lordaeron camp in its shadow, haggard and sickly, refused by their own kin.

title: Thule Ravenclaw
body: Thule Ravenclaw was a young mage of great promise in Dalaran before the war, a friend of Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus. When the Lich King rose he betrayed his brethren and went over to the Scourge. Now he holds Fenris Keep, leading the Rot Hide gnolls, whose animating ichor he brewed himself, and the undead who bear his name.

parts.body: He is destroyed at last in Fenris Keep, the young mage of Dalaran who chose the Scourge over his brethren.
sources: quest 446 description (young promising mage, betrayed his brethren, allied with the Scourge)

parts.body: Long ago he and his two friends wove their apprentice wands into one, a token of their friendship. Thule came to despise it, yet could not bear to part with it, and hid it in Fenris Keep.
